assertions.assertion: The patient presents with a history of atherosclerotic heart disease
The patient has mitral valve insufficiency
The patient reports recent episodes of transient neurological deficits
The neurological deficits are suggestive of a transient ischemic attack
A 48-hour Holter monitor is ordered for continuous rhythm assessment
The 48-hour Holter monitoring study is coded as CPT 93226
The 48-hour Holter monitoring study is medically necessary to assess the patient's arrhythmias and embolic risk consistent with the clinical indication
